_meta.description: Binary interaction data: NRTL parameters, liquid miscibility flags and solid solubility data.
_meta.nrtl_form: tau_ij = a_ij + b_ij/T + e_ij ln(T) + f_ij T ;  G_ij = exp(-alpha_ij tau_ij) ;  alpha_ij = c_ij + d_ij (T - 273.15 K)  (Aspen Plus NRTL form; T in K)
_meta.warning: All NRTL sets below were regressed to VLE data. VLE-fitted parameters reproduce G^E but usually NOT its temperature derivatives (H^E, Cp^E). Use cp_engine.models.nrtl.fit_nrtl_to_excess() to refit to H^E / Cp^E data when available.

nrtl.source: Aspen Plus databank (DDB-regressed VLE), as tabulated in the NRTL appendix reproduced in BIT Mesra CAPE notes; orientation corrected 2026-11-02 (gamma_inf acetone in water = 5.8, water in acetone = 3.6 at 298 K); tested 2026-11-05 against measured gamma_inf of acetone in water (doi:10.1021/je0495942, doi:10.1021/je049875+): 25 % low but correct temperature trend (the opposite sign of b gives the wrong trend); not phase-stable above 360 K (the engine warns)

Fitted (tools/fit_nrtl_he.py) to measured H^E from the NIST ThermoML archive: 10.1016/j.fluid.2007.06.007; 10.1016/j.fluid.2014.05.031; 10.1016/j.jct.2005.06.018; 10.1016/j.tca.2017.05.023 and to the freezing points of aqueous ethanol 2.5-56 wt% (Lange 1967) and to measured activity coefficients of ethanol at infinite dilution in water (doi:10.1021/je0495942; doi:10.1021/je049875+). Phase-stable (no liquid-liquid split) from 220 to 390 K.
Fitted (tools/fit_nrtl_he.py) to measured H^E from the NIST ThermoML archive: 10.1016/j.jct.2005.03.012; 10.1016/j.tca.2006.02.028. Phase-stable (no liquid-liquid split) from 220 to 390 K.

Fitted (tools/fit_nrtl_he.py) jointly to isobaric VLE (Chen, Zhong & Xu 2012, doi:10.1021/je200921u; Psat from NIST Antoine parameters) and Cp of the mixture at 313.15 K (Vega-Maza et al. 2011, doi:10.1016/j.jct.2011.06.019), NIST ThermoML archive. Phase-stable 250-390 K.

solubility.source: CRC Handbook aqueous solubility (mass %, 0-100 C) converted to g/100 g water, as tabulated in Wikipedia 'Solubility table' (checked: 26.28 wt% -> 35.65 g/100 g)

apparent_molar_cp.form: phiCp = c0 + d0 sqrt(m) + e m ; m in mol/kg, J/(mol K), at 298.15 K (T-dependence not available)
